findings: [6] «Это-то душа» (Eto-to dusha) reads as a slip for «Эта-то душа» (Eta-to dusha, 'it is this very soul'); translated in that sense.
[9] «смертносного» (smertnosnogo) is a misspelling of «смертоносного» (smertonosnogo, 'deadly'); translated as 'deadly'.
disposition: Retain the audited Russian source and SHA-256 unchanged. None of these readings affects meaning, so the unit is not held out of reviewed status; Confirm against the printed volume 41 at the next print-witness pass.
